CLIENT EMAIL

Choose your invitation sender.

Invitations use Wildrose email by default. To send from your agency, connect a sending subdomain you own and verify its DNS records. Your client lead notifications can use it too.

SENDER ADDRESS

Checking email setup…

After verification, invitations come from invites@ and lead notifications from leads@ on your subdomain. This sets up a sending address; it does not connect your personal mailbox.
ADD THESE EMAIL DNS RECORDS

Use each host exactly as shown by the email provider. Namecheap adds your root domain automatically; other DNS providers may ask for the full hostname.

AGENCY BILLING
One bill for your clients.
You set and collect your own client prices. Rose bills your agency for each client invited under your agency plan whose assistant is published. Existing clients who already pay Wildrose directly stay on their current billing. Volume discounts apply to additional clients automatically.
MONTHLY ESTIMATE
Loading billing…
—
Each paid client includes 75 voice minutes per month. Voice pauses at the limit unless you enable extra minutes below; chat stays available. Newly published agency-plan clients appear on the next monthly bill. Pausing a widget does not remove its subscription; removing the client from your agency stops future charges and agency delivery.

VOICE MINUTES
Choose how extra minutes work.
Each paid client gets 75 voice minutes per month. Extra minutes are off by default. Turn them on for continued voice service at — per extra minute, billed to your agency on the next invoice.
Leave blank for no cap. When a client reaches the cap, their voice pauses until the next cycle. Chat stays available.
